name: raizes-gestao
description: Raízes Personalizados · Catálogo, Orçamento e Mockups

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @raizes/server" "npm run dev -w @raizes/web"
scripts.dev:site: concurrently -k -n site,vitrine -c green,yellow "npm run dev -w @raizes/site-server" "npm run dev -w @raizes/site-web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @raizes/web && npm run build -w @raizes/server && npm run build -w @raizes/site-web && npm run build -w @raizes/site-server
